title: In This Reality
about: “Oh Jah, you have given me everything I need to be free — in this reality.” A reggae prayer of thanksgiving printed in twelve books of the collection, where it runs straight into Jah Rastafarai as a medley. The melody here follows the singing on Jah Rastafari / In This Reality (Jah Levi, Shimshai, RainbowSong) — the second half of that medley.
